tasks.task: Synthesise 5 to 15 interviews into themes, quotes and actions

items.when: When you have transcripts or notes and need coded passages, counted themes and exact quotes
When the calls are still recordings and you need transcripts with who said what
When transcripts are very long, to cut each to the few passages worth coding
When you want a second pass that ranks themes by how often they come up, with quotes
When themes are found and the team needs the top insights ranked, each with an action
Before the readout goes out, to tie every finding and quote to a named transcript

tasks.task: Write an interview guide for one research goal

items.when: When a decision depends on why customers act as they do and you need the whole round planned
When you or a moderator will run the calls and need a timed guide built on past stories
When the goal is why people bought, to try a timeline script from first thought to purchase
When the guide is drafted, to catch questions that invite polite lies and rewrite them
When questions ask what people would do, not what they did last time

tasks.task: Mine reviews for what buyers praise and hate

items.when: When you have an export of reviews and need counted themes, mood, causes and actions
Before counting anything, to flag reviews that look bought or fake and set them aside
When you want complaints, praise and requests ranked by frequency with real quotes
When the question is why people buy, to rank buying reasons in customers' exact words

tasks.task: Write or review a survey for one goal

items.when: When you know who must answer and need questions aimed at what only they know
When the goal is product fit, to try the short how-would-you-feel-without-it survey
When the survey must find a price, to add the two questions that give a price range
Before sending, to work out how many answers you need to see the difference you care about
When a draft exists, to get a bias review, a shorter question list and a pretest plan
When questions use the company's words, to put them in words a customer would use

tasks.task: Analyse survey results and write a findings brief

items.when: When results are in and you need a checked findings table with honest sampling caveats
When you have the raw export and need tables and charts by asking in plain words
When you need trends, outliers and the right test for a difference between groups
Before you report a number, to score how far each question's answers can be trusted
When the sample is small, for an honest read of what it can and cannot show
When one striking percentage is about to become the headline

tasks.task: Recruit participants with a screener and outreach

items.when: When a study needs quotas, stop rules, incentive terms and a schedule
When you need a screener that filters fairly and messages that say honestly what is asked
When you must reach strangers, to get a warm intro note, a cold message and an opening line
When you have a customer list and a reward budget and need a call plan around them

tasks.task: Draft a consent form and privacy notice for a study

items.when: Before any interview, group, diary or trial, to write plain consent text and a short notice
When you must decide what is recorded, who sees it and when it is deleted
When the study records customers or minors, to see if it needs a fuller privacy review

tasks.task: Turn research into buyer words and a fix list

items.when: When research is finished and the team needs words to use and fixes to make on Monday
When you have reviews or support emails and need buying reasons in exact words
When a writer asks for real quotes on one topic, each tied to who said it
When the client wants the buyer words carried straight into fact-based ad copy
When the swipe file drifts into the company's phrasing and away from the buyer's

tasks.task: Find the cause of bad reviews, returns or a rating drop

items.when: When a rating fell and you need to see what changed in the reviews around that date
When returns are the signal, to count reasons by product and spot listings that mislead
When you have before and after numbers, to rank likely causes by the evidence

tasks.task: Build and read a short NPS or satisfaction survey

items.when: When you want a short, regular survey after a purchase or support contact, with a why
When answers sit in a connected survey tool and you need themes and quotes for a date range
When score comments must be read with tickets and calls to get one ranked signal
Before you report the score, to check the questions and the response base hold up

tasks.task: Build a buyer profile or persona pack from evidence

items.when: When you have orders and reviews and want interviews, a profile and a brief for writers
When the interviews and tickets are done and you need personas from the patterns
When one profile feels wrong, to split buyers by how they describe themselves
When the evidence is still raw and must be coded before any persona is written
Before delivery, to check each persona trait traces to evidence a client can see

tasks.task: Map the jobs customers hire the product for

items.when: When you want one run from interview questions to a jobs map and buyer profile
When you need the practical, emotional and social jobs written out for one buyer
When you can watch buyers or catch people who just switched, to plan those contacts
When the map lists product features and not the situation that made someone look

tasks.task: Write listening queries and read a mentions export

items.when: When you use a listening tool or platform search and need queries that catch real mentions
When you have the mentions export and need themes, mood and what drove a spike
Before writing queries, to map the sites, shows and communities this buyer uses
When there is no export yet and you need what people say on a topic, grouped by theme
When the source is post comments, to pull what people ask, complain about and want
When themes are drafted, to count them and say what this sample can and cannot show

tasks.task: Write the monthly voice-of-customer report

items.when: In the first week of each month, to report what customers said the month before
When new reviews arrive monthly and you need new buyer words and new doubts tracked
When the report is long and the owner needs one page with the answer first
Before it is sent, to check every count and quote against this month's source files

tasks.task: Design and read a focus group or workshop

items.when: When customers must react together and you need the session design and the reading plan
When the moderator needs a timed guide with probes and group exercises
When the study must choose between versions and needs steps from recruit to readout
After the sessions, to rank themes across the group transcripts with quotes

tasks.task: Design a taste test or product trial and read the scores

items.when: When you must choose between recipes, packs or versions with real buyers
When you need a blind, paired or ranking design with scoring sheets and a decision rule
When a one-day public tasting is possible, to plan it with a taster card and a rule
When the scores are in, to pick the right test and say if the difference is real

tasks.task: Plan a diary study or online community task

items.when: When behaviour over days matters and you need daily tasks, prompts and a reading plan
When diarists must be recruited and told plainly what each day asks of them

tasks.task: Choose the method and write a research plan for one question

items.when: When the client has a question but no method, to pick one and plan how to store findings
When interviews are the method and you need recruiting, guide and synthesis steps in one plan
When the client has a hunch, to turn it into testable guesses and rival explanations
When budget is tight, to compare two study shapes with cost and dates and pick one
When the plan is agreed and the round must run from recruit to readout

tasks.task: Sort founder call notes into facts, praise and fluff

items.when: Before the calls, to list the founder's guesses and who can test each one
When raw call notes need facts, compliments and feature ideas told apart
After a round of talks, to weigh beliefs against notes and call keep going, change or stop

tasks.task: Score product ideas from buyer complaints

items.when: When you have a category and want the complaints that point to a gap, with a score
When an idea exists, to collect the pains, objections and buying signals people post
When complaints should become ranked design questions and a small research plan

tasks.task: Compare your reviews with rivals' reviews

items.when: When you have both review sets and need the same themes counted for each brand
When rival reviews are not collected yet and you need ratings from many sites in one report
When the rivals sell on Amazon, to find their weak spots and your best selling points

tasks.task: Plan how to earn more honest reviews

items.when: When you need the moment to ask, the wording and how to answer a bad review
When a service client needs a short ask with three easy questions and a follow-up
When the client also needs safe replies to the reviews they already have
Before the messages go out, to read them as a customer and catch any pressure or bribe

tasks.task: Read out an A/B test or experiment result

items.when: Before reading the lift, to decide whether the finished test can be trusted
When you have the test data and need a split check, ranges and a clear call
When the client needs the result and what it means explained in plain words

tasks.task: Write a decision note or strategy memo from the findings

items.when: When findings must end in a choice, with options, risks, missing facts and a review date
When a finished report needs a summary, a slide brief and a fact-check list
Before it goes to the client, to list what they would have to ask before acting on it

always.when: Before any readout leaves, to tie each count, quote and claim to a dated source
Before a guide, survey or report is shared, to catch typos and one theme named two ways

helpers.when: When the question is about market size, rivals or trends, not about your own customers
When survey or panel data needs weighting, cross-tabs or tests beyond a simple read
When the buyer words must become page, ad or email copy
When findings must turn into a scope, a priority call or a roadmap change
When the study is a usability test of a screen or prototype
When the job moves from reading reviews to replying to them and running the review programme

gaps: No library item writes a focus group discussion guide or moderator script with timed sections and group exercises
No library item designs a diary study or an online community task plan
No library item designs blind, paired or ranking taste tests with scoring sheets, or analyses panel scores
No library item writes a recruitment screener with quotas and stop rules, or sets incentive terms
No library item drafts a participant consent form or a research privacy notice
No library item codes interview or open survey text against a codebook and counts the codes
No library item builds or reads an NPS, satisfaction or effort survey as its main job
No library item writes search queries for social listening tools such as Brandwatch or Talkwalker
No library item briefs a concept board or runs a concept, name or pack test with buyers
No library item cleans a survey export or builds cross-tabs by segment
No library item offers different review request messages to compare before sending
